words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr:
adj. 中国的；
n. 中国人；汉语；
words.ex: She ate Chinese food for dinner.
words.en: Of or relating to China, its people, or their languages.

words.ex: He does his homework every evening.
words.en: Does is the third person singular in the present tense of 'do'. It is used to refer to an action or activity performed by someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: My sister walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹每天走路去上学。
words.en: A sister is a woman or girl who has one or both parents in common with another individual.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.tr:
n. 灰色；
adj. 灰色的；暗淡的；
words.ex: The sky turned gray before the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前，天空变成了灰色。
words.en: Gray is an intermediate color between black and white, often associated with gloom or dullness.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr:
int. 对不起；抱歉；
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的；
words.ex: Sorry, I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.ex: The children built a snowman in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里堆了一个雪人。
words.en: A snowman is a large shape which is made out of snow, especially by children, and is supposed to look like a person.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.
words.en: If you say that a person or their behavior is cool, you mean that they are calm and unemotional, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This book is hers.
words.en: used to refer to something belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

words.ex: This book is ours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我们的人或物。
words.en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

words.ex: The books are theirs.
words.en: You use theirs to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He rides his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去学校。
words.en: A bike is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet. You steer it by turning a bar that is connected to the front wheel.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.en: A cat is a small furry animal with a tail, whiskers, and sharp claws. Cats are often kept as pets.

words.ex: Our dog sleeps on the floor.
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the speaker and one or more other people previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: He carries his schoolbag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天背着书包去学校。
words.en: A bag used by a student to carry books and other school supplies.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: I saw him yesterday.
words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: She could swim when she was five.
words.en: Used to indicate possibility or ability in the past, or to make a polite request.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: I write letters to my pen pal every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周给我的笔友写信。
words.en: A pen pal is someone you write friendly letters to and receive letters from, although the two of you may never have met.

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: He eats a lot of ice cream.
words.en: A large number or amount; a great deal.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He has a little money left.
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: I do not like spinach at all.
words.en: Used to emphasize that you are not in the least bit tired, interested, etc.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: My brother plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.ex: He sits on the sofa every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都坐在沙发上。
words.en: A sofa is a long, comfortable seat with a back and usually with arms, which two or three people can sit on.

words.tr: n. 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母
words.ex: My grandparent lives in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A grandparent is the parent of your father or mother.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: He drew a family tree for his school project.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校的作业画了一张家谱。
words.en: A diagram showing the relationships between people in several generations of a family.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: Its color is blue.
words.en: Belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: He eats rice every day.
words.en: Rice is a cereal grain that is the most widely consumed staple food for a large part of the world's human population, especially in Asia.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: Bread is a food made from flour, water, and usually yeast, mixed together and baked.

words.ex: He eats a hamburger for lunch.
words.en: A hamburger is a cooked patty of ground meat, usually beef, placed inside a sliced bread roll or bun.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: Thank you, sir.
words.en: A polite or formal way of addressing a man, especially one whose name you do not know or a man of higher rank or status.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.tr: int. 嗯（表示思考或犹豫）
words.ex: Hmm, I'm not sure if I should go.
words.ex_cn: 嗯，我不确定我是否该去。
words.en: Used to express agreement, understanding, or contemplation.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.tr: phrase. 期待；盼望（常与 to 连用）
words.ex: I look forward to seeing you next week.
words.en: to anticipate something with pleasure

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: Madam, can you help me with this question?
words.ex_cn: 夫人，您能帮我回答这个问题吗？
words.en: A polite form of address for a woman, especially one who is married or of higher social status.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.ex: He is seventy years old.
words.en: The number 70.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.en: The number 30.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: He has sixty apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有六十个苹果。
words.en: The number 60.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.en: The number 80.

words.ex: He is ninety years old.
words.en: the number 90

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: The factory uses coke to heat the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用焦炭来加热熔炉。
words.en: Coke is a solid fuel made by heating coal in the absence of air so that the volatile components are driven off. It is also a popular brand of soft drink.

words.ex: She will do some shopping this afternoon.
words.en: To go to stores or shops in order to buy things.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.ex: He made an error in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: An error is a mistake.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；自由的；
adv. 免费地；自由地；
v. 释放；
words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆在周日免费入场。
words.en: If someone is free, they are able to do what they want to do, or go where they want to go, without being controlled or restricted.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.tr: phrase. 西山；西方的山丘（常用于地名或描述方位）
words.ex: The West Hill offers a great view of the city.
words.ex_cn: 西山提供了城市的美景。
words.en: A hill located to the west.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.ex: I have to go to school every day.
words.en: If you have to do something, it is necessary for you to do it.

words.tr:
v. 飞翔；飞行；
n. 苍蝇；
words.ex: Birds fly in the sky.
words.en: To move through the air using wings; or a small insect with two wings.

words.ex: The boy is flying a kite in the park.
words.en: A kite is a toy consisting of a light frame covered with paper, cloth, or plastic, which you fly in the air at the end of one or more long strings. It is also a bird of prey with long pointed wings and a forked tail.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.tr: n. （非正式）狗，汪汪; v. 狗叫；模仿狗叫; int. 模仿的狗叫声，汪汪的叫声
words.ex: The dog made a bow-wow sound when it saw its owner.
words.ex_cn: 狗看到主人时发出了汪汪的声音。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; a dog.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: We have dinner together in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.tr: phrase. 完成家庭作业；做好准备工作
words.ex: He does his homework every evening after school.
words.ex_cn: 他每天放学后都做家庭作业。
words.en: To do one's homework means to prepare thoroughly for something, especially by gathering information or doing research.

words.ex: The panda is eating bamboo in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊猫在动物园里吃竹子。
words.en: A panda is a large, black-and-white bear-like mammal native to China, known for its distinctive markings and diet consisting almost entirely of bamboo.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The train leaves at five o'clock.
words.en: You use o'clock after numbers from one to twelve to say what time it is. For example, if you say that it is 9 o'clock, you mean that it is nine hours after midnight or nine hours after noon.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.tr: abbr. 上午；午前；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. every day.
words.en: used when referring to a time between midnight and noon

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.tr: abbr. 下午；午后；“post meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: The meeting starts at 3 p.m.
words.en: Used after a time to indicate that it is in the afternoon or evening.

words.ex: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.
